name: LTX 2.3 · CrossView camera move

recamera_video.note: Re-shoots an existing clip from another camera angle and keeps its motion. Measured on an RTX 3090 on 2026-09-19 (docs/crossview-warp-ab.md): on a generated shot at +/-25 degrees the characters, the vehicles and the action survived and the angle changed both ways. Built by tools/build_crossview_template.py, not exported from a canvas.

description: Re-shoots your generated video from a new camera angle, keeping the motion. Runs on your GPU; nothing leaves this machine.

sourceVideo.note: The clip to re-shoot. It is warped by depth (MoGe) into the new camera and also given to the model as itself, which is what carries identity.

frames.note: 8n+1 like every LTX preset, but rounded DOWN: the frames past the end of the source have nothing to be re-shot from. Capped at 121 (5 s at 24 fps) until a longer run has been measured on a 24 GB card.

camera.note: Degrees, not words: CrossView-Warp takes the angle as a number, so a 15 degree move is a 15 degree move. The ranges are the LoRA card's 'usable' band; its 'reliable' band is +/-45 azimuth and -20..+30 elevation. Distance is refused because the author says it does not work in v2. Positive azimuth is camera right, as in the editor: checked by parallax on the 2026-09-19 runs.

azimuth.rangeMessage: This camera move takes up to 90 degrees left or right; past 45 the model invents most of what it shows.

elevation.rangeMessage: This camera move takes the camera from 35 degrees below to 45 degrees above the shot.

unsupported.positive: The video camera move cannot dolly yet: its model was barely trained on distance. Reset the dolly and try the angle alone.
unsupported.negative: The video camera move cannot dolly yet: its model was barely trained on distance. Reset the dolly and try the angle alone.

unsupported.positive: The video camera move cannot roll the camera.
unsupported.negative: The video camera move cannot roll the camera.

unsupported.positive: The video camera move cannot pan the camera.
unsupported.negative: The video camera move cannot pan the camera.

unsupported.positive: The video camera move cannot pan the camera.
unsupported.negative: The video camera move cannot pan the camera.

prompt.note: The graph ships the LoRA's one-word trigger, 'Crossview.', and nothing is composed into it.

$FRAMES.note: how many frames of the clip to re-shoot; 8n+1, rounded down

$AZIMUTH.note: degrees, camera right positive; written from the camera, never sent directly

$ELEVATION.note: degrees, camera up positive; written from the camera, never sent directly

$CHECKPOINT.note: chosen from requires.checkpoints, never by the caller

nodePacks.note: cseti007, Apache-2.0. Install by git clone into custom_nodes; no pip packages. Reviewed 2026-09-19: no network, subprocess or eval.

nodePacks.note: Chosen over core LoadVideo for frame_load_cap and force_rate: the clip has to come in at 24 fps and at exactly the frame count the latent is built for.

models.note: MIT. The depth the LoRA was trained on; the author measured Depth Anything V2 at twice the warp error.

compatibility.note: Measured on a 24 GB RTX 3090 only.
